title: RFE: Insulin Pens - Changing insulin types
body:
After digging through the code, it appears that it is not possible to edit the JSON file that stores the insulin types, due to Android security permissions. Switching this to an issue and a request for a feature: possibly just adding an option to the Insulin Pens menu to forget a saved device. Changing the insulin type in a pen is trivial, it should also be trivial to reset the insulin pen (or 'forget' it so it can set up again) in the xDrip UI as well. Original discussion text follows: ### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3322
Originally posted by **Loquacity** January 29, 2024 Hi everyone, I'm using two 'smart' insulin pens, both are NovoPen 6, and both are currently being used with my basal insulin (Levemir, although they're saved in xDrip as Lantus, since Levemir was not an available insulin type at the time). With the release of my bolus insulin (Fiasp) in a penfill, I am hoping to switch to using one smart pen for bolus instead, and the other for basal. I thought that if I could get xDrip to 'forget' my pens, then I could re-add them on the next dose, and be able to set them up with the correct insulin, but I can't see a way to do that. Is there some way to either have xDrip 'forget' the pen, or a way to manually change which type of insulin the pen is using? Thanks for all the help!
